randomization.cpa_seed: baseline seed + batch_index, identical for all candidates
randomization.fia_seed: baseline FIA seed42, identical for all candidates
randomization.ranking: relative L2 of recompressed reconstructed-data SGD update to received packet
randomization.ranking_labels: public round0 model argmax; no true labels
randomization.final_selection: lowest same observable relative L2 among three final candidates
